evaluation_rounds.question: Does the protected-panel advantage of checkpoint-100352 over checkpoint-120832 generalize to a disjoint research panel, and is either late checkpoint sufficiently reliable to support closure and possible final assessment?
evaluation_rounds.reason: The baseline used PPO with the unchanged recipe and completed 120832 steps. Training reward peaked at checkpoint-90112, while the training success proxy peaked at checkpoint-100352 and then stayed near 0.93-0.95. On the recorded research panel, checkpoint-100352 and checkpoint-120832 both achieved 151/160 successes (94.375%), while on the reused task-reference-v1 panel they achieved 196/200 (98%) and 194/200 (97%), respectively. The task-reference result that favors checkpoint-100352 was also used to select that candidate, so it is not independent confirmation. A disjoint panel can change whether checkpoint-100352 remains the working or best-known choice, whether checkpoint-120832 is preferable, and whether closure should request the official benchmark.
